### 506(b) vs 506(c): What’s the Difference for Real Estate Syndicators?


By Alex Field | 08/21/26 | Announcements


Before a syndicator raises a dollar, one structural question shapes everything downstream: is this offering 506(b) or 506(c)? The answer determines who you can talk to, how you can find investors, and what paperwork the raise requires. In short, 506(b) lets you raise privately from people you know with light verification.
